page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r6a.2xlarge is a memory-optimized instance powered by an AMD EPYC 7H12 processor running on the x86_64 architecture. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The system is equipped with 64.0 GB of RAM, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps under a KVM hypervisor.

Benchmark data indicates moderate overall performance. The instance achieves average results in Geekbench single-core and multi-core tests, Passmark CPU and memory scores, and static web serving throughput. However, raw computational throughput is limited, as shown by poor single-core and weak multi-core stress-ng CPU benchmarks. Memory bandwidth for cached small blocks is average, but drops to weak for uncached large-block read and write operations.

Given its hardware profile, this instance offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive workloads that do not require high-frequency CPU performance or local NVMe storage. The high RAM density makes it suitable for database operations, caching layers, and memory-bound enterprise applications, though workloads requiring heavy parallel processing or high-speed local disk I/O may encounter performance bottlenecks.
